dispositions.disposition: Empty requirements and out-of-range wall room ordinals are not established as reachable through the inspected successful ordinary allocation path.
dispositions.trace: generate_structure calls generate_storeys. Outside the separate small-church early return, it rejects every storey with an empty rooms list before allocate_storey. allocate validates each reservation ordinal against a requirements-sized vector; passage and new room seeds use indices obtained from that same list, and growth copies an already assigned neighbouring room. derive_walls obtains each wall ordinal from those assignments and serializes RoomIndex without changing its value. derive_openings passes the same requirements and walls to entrances::append: its selected entrance index is a position in the nonempty list or zero, and its merchant rear-wall indexing receives those generated wall ordinals. If these inspected steps succeed in that sequence, the cited direct indexes are within that list.
dispositions.limits: This does not validate arbitrary deserialized RoomIndex or WallSegment values, direct private calls with unrelated lists, the small-church separate path, all other index operations, room connectivity, produced entrance availability, or error behavior. No allocation, generation, test or runtime probe was performed.
